comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body:
If anyone remembers the Plague Epidemic event from long time ago i.e. you had to buy Senna from Calicut to deliver to a port in Europe... it works in a similar fashion for this event. You buy fiber type goods from a port in the Carib and sell in Europe for a profit to count. Heres what works:

Buying hemp From Santiago.
Buying Kenaf from Havana.
(note that Ivryo doesn't list these at purchasable in those ports, but they are there if you invest).
If your Dutch, buying Sisal from Willemstad will work too.
Strangely enough, while buying Sisal from Willemstad will work, it does not if it's from Caracas. So Venetian players will have to use the Santiago/Havana route.
And like the plague event, collecting from land areas wont count.

Were you in a fleet, Dvc80? Most Historical events go by much quicker if you're fleeted with others, or so it seems.
